pages.text: $(l)Prioritize passive automation$() for key Chapter 4 resources: AE2 processors, Mystical Agriculture seeds, chickens, Blood Magic slates, Stargate materials, fission fuels, basic and advanced circuits, abyssalnite/dreadium, and all Botania components and

Essentia. Passive them as soon as you can to avoid bottlenecks later.$(br2)$(l)Armor progression in Chapter 4$(): Skip Sacrifice Metal (unavailable here). Use Mithminite/Superenchanted Maid → Stellar/Mithminite → Draconic.
Stellar is viable and superior to Bloodmaster until Draconic; it grants Revealing, creative flight, speed, and 95% damage reduction with Empowered upgrades.

$(l)EMC pitfalls$(): Avoid EMC Links for automatic input—they’re buggy. Use an EMC Cell instead (if available). Also, $(o)always$() check EMC value before crafting; some items (e.g., Divine Rock) are cheaper to transmute. For recipes needing duplicate inputs, use the Spinning Wheel with 64 crafts at once for efficiency.
